title: assistant-docs Skill Behavior Eval Fixtures
description: Provider-neutral offline eval cases for the assistant-docs skill's code-derived documentation workflow.
recommended_use: Run each case with the assistant-docs skill instructions loaded.
Compare the local response against documentation input/output contracts, evidence, coverage, and review-items/evidence/safety handling.
Use deterministic substring checks as offline proxies for contract adherence, not semantic grading.

cases.title: Architecture doc uses code evidence
cases.purpose: Checks that architecture documentation is generated from code evidence and returns files_updated, evidence_sources, doc_coverage, review_items, safety_notes, and gaps.
cases.prompt: Write architecture documentation for the skill eval runner modules under tools/evals/.
setup_context: The assistant-docs skill instructions are active.
The user requested architecture docs for a concrete module.
The target module has source files and existing docs to inspect.
expected_behavior: Resolves doc_type as architecture and scope as the skill eval runner.
Reads source_files and existing docs before describing architecture.
Updates or proposes documentation with files_updated entries.
Returns Evidence tied to source files, not memory.
Returns doc_coverage with documented areas and remaining gaps.
Lists inferred architecture claims in review_items and includes evidence_sources plus safety_notes.

When an Architecture Decision Pack applies, preserves its freshness, facts versus assumptions, design-pressure checks, semantic type or primitive-boundary rationale, and quality verification rather than asserting unmeasured benefits.
pass_criteria: The response names doc_type, scope, and source_files or evidence.
The response includes files_updated, evidence_sources, doc_coverage, review_items, and safety_notes.
The response cites actual tools/evals files.
The response flags inferred claims or gaps for review.
The response treats memory, performance, or extensibility claims as review-needed unless workload, budget or explicit unknown, measurement, and failure condition are documented.
The response does not document hallucinated features.
fail_signals: Writes docs from memory without reading code.
Claims full coverage while gaps remain.
Omits review_items despite inferred architecture claims.
Documents features that are not in the source.

forbidden_substrings: No review needed for inferred claims

cases.title: Changelog doc uses git history
cases.purpose: Checks that changelog documentation uses git history or supplied commits and marks inferred release notes for review.
cases.prompt: Generate a changelog entry for the latest skill eval coverage work.
setup_context: The assistant-docs skill instructions are active.
The user asks for changelog documentation.
No commit range was explicitly supplied.
expected_behavior: Resolves doc_type as changelog and identifies the scope.
Uses git history or asks for a range when latest work is ambiguous.
Returns files_updated with the changelog target path and change_type.
Returns doc_coverage with included and omitted changes.
Lists inferred release wording in review_items and includes evidence_sources plus safety_notes.
Does not invent issue numbers, versions, or features absent from evidence.
pass_criteria: The response uses git log or requests a commit range.
The response includes files_updated, evidence_sources, doc_coverage, review_items, and safety_notes.
The response distinguishes evidence-backed entries from gaps.
The response does not invent versions or features.
fail_signals: Creates changelog text without commit or source evidence.
Invents version numbers, issue IDs, or release dates.
Marks review_items empty for inferred release notes.
Omits coverage or gaps.

cases.title: Architecture docs trace a fresh Pack without copying it
cases.purpose: Checks that applicable architecture documentation consumes the compact fresh Pack projection and returns a trace instead of recreating architecture decisions.
cases.prompt: Document the architecture decision carried by the fresh workflow Architecture Decision Pack for the parser boundary. Return exactly one complete valid JSON object and no surrounding prose.
setup_context: The assistant-docs skill instructions are active.
architecture_design_mode is required and architecture_decision_pack_status is current.

A fresh compact architecture_decision_pack projection has ref=pack/parser-boundary, mode=required, canonical freshness_basis, facts=[{claim,source_ref}], assumptions=[{statement=The current parser format remains supported,status=safe_default,rationale_or_impact=Existing callers rely on it,source_ref=null}], canonical material_questions, boundaries_and_dependencies, design_pressure_checks, type_ledger, quality_scenarios, verification_and_rollback, invalidators, and no review-intensive challenge evidence. The current canonical Pack ref resolves the selected design and rationale.

The carried parser-boundary behavior claim has exact current feature_preparation_evidence_refs binding {evidence_ref=prep/parser-boundary,item_id=parser-boundary-compatibility,claim_or_question=Preserve the current parser boundary compatibility while documenting the selected design.}.
expected_behavior: Uses the source Pack ref, matching mode, and canonical freshness basis before documenting the decision.
Preserves facts[{claim,source_ref}] and assumptions[{statement,status=safe_default,rationale_or_impact,source_ref=null}] without translating or dropping nullable source_ref.
Documents canonical material questions, boundaries/dependencies, design-pressure checks, Type Ledger, quality scenarios, verification/rollback, and invalidators without copying the full Pack.

Resolves selected design and rationale through the current canonical Pack ref and returns architecture_decision_pack_trace with source_pack_ref, documented_decision_refs, evidence_refs, exact feature_preparation_evidence_refs bindings, and review_trace.

Returns a separately mandatory top-level feature_preparation_evidence_trace outcome=validated with exactly one carried evidence_ref, item_id, and claim_or_question binding plus a non-empty review_trace.
pass_criteria: The response names architecture_design_mode, architecture_decision_pack_status=current, and architecture_decision_pack.
The response includes architecture_decision_pack_trace, source_pack_ref, and documented_decision_refs.
The response includes a separately validated top-level feature_preparation_evidence_trace with exactly the carried evidence binding and review trace.
The response keeps unverified or stale decision claims in review_trace or review_items.
The response does not invent a new decision, freshness basis, or quality result.
fail_signals: Reconstructs a Pack from memory or generic architecture prose.
Omits Pack source, evidence, or review trace.
Claims a quality benefit without the carried verification evidence.

required_substrings: resolves selected design and rationale through the current canonical Pack ref

expected_values: Preserve the current parser boundary compatibility while documenting the selected design.

structured_json_assertions.expected: Preserve the current parser boundary compatibility while documenting the selected design.

expected_values: Preserve the current parser boundary compatibility while documenting the selected design.

cases.title: Architecture docs reject a missing or stale Pack
cases.purpose: Checks that Pack-backed architecture documentation stops safely instead of inventing a decision when its Pack is unavailable or stale.
cases.prompt: Document the architecture decision, but the Pack ref is missing and its last revision predates a changed public contract.
setup_context: The assistant-docs skill instructions are active.
architecture_design_mode is review_intensive and architecture_decision_pack_status is stale.
The carried Pack is stale; a stale ref may be unavailable.
expected_behavior: Does not reconstruct, infer, or invent a missing or stale Pack.
Stops documentation of the affected decision and returns architecture_decision_pack_trace outcome=blocked_stale_pack with recovery_action rather than invented refs.
Records the gap in review_items rather than presenting the stale decision as current.
pass_criteria: The response identifies the stale Pack and does not write decision claims from it.
The response requests a fresh Pack or marks the decision out of scope without requiring source_pack_ref, documented_decision_refs, or evidence_refs.
The response includes review_items or review_trace for the unresolved decision.
fail_signals: Reuses a stale Pack as current evidence.
Invents missing review-intensive challenge evidence.
Completes Pack-backed documentation without a source Pack ref.

cases.title: Architecture docs block a missing Pack without writing files
cases.purpose: Checks the typed no-write recovery path when an applicable Pack is unavailable.
cases.prompt: Document the carried architecture decision, but its Pack cannot be found.
setup_context: The assistant-docs skill instructions are active.
architecture_design_mode is required and architecture_decision_pack_status=missing.
architecture_decision_pack_issue has status=missing, concrete recovery evidence, and recovery_action=request_current_pack.
expected_behavior: Returns architecture_decision_pack_trace outcome=blocked_missing_pack.
Returns recovery_action=request_current_pack with non-empty review_trace and recovery evidence.
Does not create documentation files or invent Pack, source, decision, or evidence refs.
pass_criteria: The response names architecture_decision_pack_status=missing.
The response names outcome=blocked_missing_pack and recovery_action=request_current_pack.
The response records non-empty review_trace and recovery evidence.
The response omits files_updated.
fail_signals: Documents the missing decision anyway.
Creates files_updated or invents a Pack reference.
Reports outcome=documented.

cases.title: Architecture docs mark an out-of-scope Pack decision without writing files
cases.purpose: Checks the typed no-write recovery path when a Pack decision is explicitly out of scope.
cases.prompt: Document the architecture decision, but the carried decision is explicitly out of scope for this documentation request.
setup_context: The assistant-docs skill instructions are active.
architecture_design_mode is lightweight and architecture_decision_pack_status=out_of_scope.
architecture_decision_pack_issue has status=out_of_scope, concrete recovery evidence, and recovery_action=mark_decision_out_of_scope.
expected_behavior: Returns architecture_decision_pack_trace outcome=out_of_scope.
Returns recovery_action=mark_decision_out_of_scope with non-empty review_trace and recovery evidence.
Does not create documentation files or invent Pack, source, decision, or evidence refs.
pass_criteria: The response names architecture_decision_pack_status=out_of_scope.
The response names outcome=out_of_scope and recovery_action=mark_decision_out_of_scope.
The response records non-empty review_trace and recovery evidence.
The response omits files_updated.
fail_signals: Documents the out-of-scope decision anyway.
Creates files_updated or invents a Pack reference.
Reports outcome=documented.

cases.title: Clear doc request proceeds without ritual question
cases.purpose: Checks that a clear documentation request proceeds from source evidence without asking random clarification questions.
cases.prompt: Update the README setup section from the package scripts and existing install docs.
setup_context: The assistant-docs skill instructions are active.
The requested doc_type, scope, and source files can be inferred from repo context.
No user preference is needed before inspecting files.
expected_behavior: Infers doc_type as README and scope as setup instructions.
Reads package scripts and existing install docs before writing.
Proceeds without asking a ritual clarification question.
Records assumptions or review needs if evidence is incomplete.
pass_criteria: The response identifies inferred doc_type and scope.
The response uses source evidence.
The response does not ask a broad generic question.
The response records review needs or assumptions when needed.
fail_signals: Asks what documentation to update despite the prompt being clear.
Asks a random preference question before reading source files.
Writes from memory without source evidence.

cases.title: Architecture docs block a fresh Pack with incomplete feature evidence
cases.purpose: Checks that documentation does not propagate a Product question merely because the Architecture Decision Pack is fresh.
cases.prompt: Document the current architecture decision for the read-only VIEWING route. Return the complete response as one valid JSON object.
setup_context: architecture_design_mode is required and architecture_decision_pack_status=current.
The Pack is fresh but carries a Product question whose feature-preparation row has requirements evidence only; implementation and behavioral tests were not inspected.
feature_preparation_evidence_status=incomplete.
expected_behavior: Does not create documentation or restate the unsupported Product question as a decision.
Returns architecture_decision_pack_trace outcome=blocked_incomplete_pack.
Returns recovery_action=request_complete_pack and a review trace explaining the missing implementation/test evidence.
Does not invent feature_preparation_evidence_refs.
pass_criteria: The response blocks the documentation decision despite Pack freshness.
The recovery points to the missing implementation and test evidence.
fail_signals: Documents the Product question as settled architecture.
Claims a fresh Pack alone proves semantic completeness.

cases.title: Feature-preparation docs block incomplete evidence without an Architecture Pack
cases.purpose: Checks that omitting an Architecture Decision Pack cannot bypass the evidence gate for a feature, epic, story, or spike preparation document.
cases.prompt: Write the technical preparation document for the read-only VIEWING route without an Architecture Decision Pack. Return the complete response as one valid JSON object.
setup_context: feature_preparation_scope=existing_system and architecture_design_mode=not_applicable.
The preparation material proposes a Product question based only on requirements omission.
Current implementation and behavioral tests were not inspected, so feature_preparation_evidence_status=incomplete.
expected_behavior: Does not create or update the requested document.
Returns feature_preparation_evidence_trace outcome=blocked_incomplete_evidence.
Returns recovery_action=request_complete_evidence and a review trace naming the missing implementation and behavioral-test inspection.
Does not manufacture an Architecture Decision Pack merely to express the recovery.
pass_criteria: The response blocks the unsupported feature-preparation claim without Pack coupling.
The recovery requests the canonical implementation/test evidence.
fail_signals: Writes the document because architecture_design_mode is not_applicable.
Propagates the Product question based only on requirements omission.

cases.title: Feature-preparation docs retain exact evidence-row bindings
cases.purpose: Checks that a current existing-system documentation claim retains its exact canonical evidence artifact, row, and claim binding rather than only a broad artifact ref.
cases.prompt: Document the tested selection, map highlight, and viewport-focus behavior for the read-only VIEWING route. Return the complete response as one valid JSON object.
setup_context: feature_preparation_scope=existing_system, feature_preparation_evidence_status=current, and architecture_design_mode=not_applicable.
prep/viewing-route item viewing-route-effects contains inspected implementation and behavioral-test evidence for the carried preservation claim.
The exact carried claim is: Preserve selection, map highlight, and viewport focus for VIEWING without enabling editing.
expected_behavior: Writes the documentation only after carrying the exact prep/viewing-route, viewing-route-effects, and claim binding.
Returns feature_preparation_evidence_trace outcome=validated with the same exact binding and a non-empty review_trace.
Does not replace the row binding with a broad artifact-only evidence ref.
pass_criteria: The evidence trace identifies the exact canonical artifact and row.
The evidence trace retains exactly the carried claim and includes a non-empty review trace.
The response creates or updates the requested document from current evidence.
fail_signals: Uses only prep/viewing-route without its item_id.
Writes the document with a mismatched or generic claim binding.
Treats the current artifact as evidence for an unbound claim.

structured_json_assertions.expected: Preserve selection, map highlight, and viewport focus for VIEWING without enabling editing.

expected_values: Preserve selection, map highlight, and viewport focus for VIEWING without enabling editing.

cases.title: Feature-preparation docs reject a mismatched evidence row
cases.purpose: Checks that a current-looking artifact ref cannot document a carried claim when its item_id points at a different canonical evidence row.
cases.prompt: Document the tested selection, map highlight, and viewport-focus behavior for the read-only VIEWING route. Return the complete response as one valid JSON object.
setup_context: feature_preparation_scope=existing_system and architecture_design_mode=not_applicable.
The supplied binding uses evidence_ref=prep/viewing-route with item_id=unrelated-route-effects for the VIEWING preservation claim.
Only viewing-route-effects is the admissible row for the carried claim, so the supplied binding is mismatched and feature_preparation_evidence_status must be treated as incomplete.
expected_behavior: Does not create or update the requested document.
Returns feature_preparation_evidence_trace outcome=blocked_incomplete_evidence with request_complete_evidence.
Names the mismatched item and requests the exact canonical row binding.
pass_criteria: The response rejects the mismatched item despite the broad artifact ref being current.
The recovery requests the exact evidence row before documentation.
fail_signals: Writes the document because prep/viewing-route exists.
Silently replaces unrelated-route-effects with a guessed item.
Treats a broad evidence ref as sufficient.

cases.title: Feature-preparation docs reject a mismatched evidence claim
cases.purpose: Checks that a current canonical row cannot document a claim that differs from the exact carried evidence claim.
cases.prompt: Document the tested selection, map highlight, and viewport-focus behavior for the read-only VIEWING route. Return the complete response as one valid JSON object.
setup_context: feature_preparation_scope=existing_system and architecture_design_mode=not_applicable.
The supplied binding uses evidence_ref=prep/viewing-route and item_id=viewing-route-effects, but claim_or_question says editing is enabled for VIEWING.
The admissible carried claim is: Preserve selection, map highlight, and viewport focus for VIEWING without enabling editing.
expected_behavior: Does not create or update the requested document.
Returns feature_preparation_evidence_trace outcome=blocked_incomplete_evidence with request_complete_evidence.
Requests the exact carried claim binding before documentation.
pass_criteria: The response rejects the mismatched claim despite a correct artifact and item.
The recovery requests the exact evidence claim before documentation.
fail_signals: Writes the document because the artifact and item are current.
Silently replaces the claim with a guessed binding.
Treats a row ref as sufficient without its carried claim.
